about: BN4's SidBmbo1 B (78) against the registry's row 571 (the unit of BN4's misc 5, power 80): picked on the first Custom screen and used at fight frame 30 against BN4's Mettaur (140 HP) at (5,2). The bamboo, the third kind's 0x44, comes up three columns ahead of MegaMan from t33 to t95 and strikes the Mettaur at t41 in both: 60 HP left.
